createWorld.tab.cubicchunks.title: Cubic Worlds
selectWorld.cubicChunks.info: Stores the world in 32-block cubes, so it can be far taller and deeper than vanilla. Fixed once the world is made; players need Cubic Worlds to join it.
selectWorld.cubicChunks.unsupported: This world type has no cubic terrain, so it is made without Cubic Worlds, which is for world types that bring their own.
selectWorld.cubicChunks.range: Cubic worlds in this game can reach from Y %s to %s, and %s blocks out from 0 on x and z (the world border; vanilla reaches 29,999,984). The heightLimit setting in config/cubicworlds_common.toml decides this: a taller limit reaches less far out (restart to change it).
disconnect.cubicchunks.heightLimit: This server runs Cubic Worlds with heightLimit %s and this game runs it with %s. Set the same value in config/cubicworlds_common.toml and restart.
